plan.notes: Official CSUDH Academic Catalog 2025-2026, Business Administration B.S. program page, 'Business Analytics: Cyber Security Track' 4-Year Roadmap (Plan of Study Grid). GENUINE CATALOG ANOMALY: the source prints Total Hours 126, not 120. Semester sums: 15+15+15+16+17+18+15+15 = 126, which reconciles exactly with the printed 126 — kept verbatim. STALE GE LETTERING kept verbatim (A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, C1, C2, C3, D1, D2, D3, E, F). 'Cyber Security Track Course (from list below; not yet taken)' slots (4 courses) reference the footnote: complete 4 from CIS 275, 375, 378, 478, 482, 482, 488, 496 ('482' duplicated in the source footnote — kept verbatim). 'Analytics Concentration Elective (CIS 380 or CIS 480 or OMG 423)' modeled as choice slots. ENG 350 is the GWAR-satisfying course. Prereq arrays empty: the roadmap publishes no per-course prerequisites and none are invented.
